0111:   # This method is how each Pokémon is compiled from the PBS files listing
0112:   # Battle Tower/Cup Pokémon.
0113:   def self.fromInspected(str)
0114:     insp = str.gsub(/^\s+/, "").gsub(/\s+$/, "")
0115:     pieces = insp.split(/\s*;\s*/)
0116:     species = (GameData::Species.exists?(pieces[0])) ? GameData::Species.get(pieces[0]).id : nil
0117:     item = (GameData::Item.exists?(pieces[1])) ? GameData::Item.get(pieces[1]).id : nil
0118:     nature = (GameData::Nature.exists?(pieces[2])) ? GameData::Nature.get(pieces[2]).id : nil
0119:     ev = pieces[3].split(/\s*,\s*/)
0120:     ev_array = []
0121:     ev.each do |stat|
0122:       case stat.upcase
0123:       when "HP"          then ev_array.push(:HP)
0124:       when "ATK"         then ev_array.push(:ATTACK)
0125:       when "DEF"         then ev_array.push(:DEFENSE)
0126:       when "SA", "SPATK" then ev_array.push(:SPECIAL_ATTACK)
0127:       when "SD", "SPDEF" then ev_array.push(:SPECIAL_DEFENSE)
0128:       when "SPD"         then ev_array.push(:SPEED)
0129:       end
0130:     end
0131:     moves = pieces[4].split(/\s*,\s*/)
0132:     moveid = []
0133:     Pokemon::MAX_MOVES.times do |i|
0134:       move_data = GameData::Move.try_get(moves[i])
0135:       moveid.push(move_data.id) if move_data
0136:     end
0137:     moveid.push(GameData::Move.keys.first) if moveid.length == 0   # Get any one move
0138:     return self.new(species, item, nature, moveid[0], moveid[1], moveid[2], moveid[3], ev_array)
0139:   end

0141:   def self.fromPokemon(pkmn)

0143:     mov2 = (pkmn.moves[1]) ? pkmn.moves[1].id : nil
0144:     mov3 = (pkmn.moves[2]) ? pkmn.moves[2].id : nil
0145:     mov4 = (pkmn.moves[3]) ? pkmn.moves[3].id : nil
0146:     ev_array = []
0147:     GameData::Stat.each_main do |s|
0148:       ev_array.push(s.id) if pkmn.ev[s.id] > 60
0149:     end
0150:     return self.new(pkmn.species, pkmn.item_id, pkmn.nature,
0151:                     mov1, mov2, mov3, mov4, ev_array)
